topics.openingLine: A ball goes up and comes back down. If I ask when it is at a certain height, why could there be two answers?

topics.title: The shape of the periodic table

topics.title: How a loom ran on punched cards

topics.title: Why Saturn has rings

topics.openingLine: Those rings look solid, but they're not. If you could fly through one, what do you think you'd actually hit?

topics.title: Why still frames look like motion

topics.title: Why Plato and Aristotle disagreed
